import json,subprocess,uuid,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/trial');root=base/'project';root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
files={
'AGENTS.md':'# Pilot assignment
Read SDP/authority.md and selected work. No delegation. Only normalize.go and normalize_test.go may change. Never edit SDP records, go.mod or unrelated.txt. This is a disposable live workflow test authorized by PLAN-SDP-0018 PGI3. Use the available Go toolchain.
',
'SDP/SDP-project.manifest.yaml':"schemaVersion: '1.0'
project:
  name: pgi3-live
",
'SDP/KanBan/active/card.md':'| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| id | KB-PILOT-001 |
| PlanId | MAINT-PILOT-0001 |
| CardState | in-progress |
',
'SDP/Maintenance/Plan.md':'# Bounded label-normalization fix

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| id | MAINT-PILOT-0001 |
| PlanType | MaintenancePlan |
| state | active |

M1: NormalizeLabel must trim surrounding Unicode whitespace while preserving interior whitespace and case. Fix only normalize.go and normalize_test.go. Verify go test ./...; retain the unrelated file. No delegation, publication or records editing.
',
'SDP/Sessions/session.md':'# Live pilot goal

| State | Step | Work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active | S1 | Fix normalization and verify preservation |

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Session reference | SESSION-PILOT-0001 |
| Status | active |
',
'SDP/authority.md':'Owner continuation on 2026-10-07 authorizes PLAN-SDP-0018 PGI3 live bounded Maintenance verification. This disposable fixture exercises that selected scope. Fix Unicode boundary whitespace normalization; do not expand scope or invoke child agents. Canonical SDP documents must remain byte-identical.
',
'SDP/ProjectManagement/Ledger.ndjson':json.dumps({'schemaVersion':'1.0','eventId':'EVT-KB-PILOT-000001','eventType':'x-kanban:created','subjectId':'KB-PILOT-001','payload':{'schemaVersion':'0.2','previousEventId':None,'to':'active','toPath':'active/card.md'}})+'
'+json.dumps({'schemaVersion':'1.0','eventId':'EVT-PM-PILOT-000001','eventType':'x-management:started','subjectId':'MAINT-PILOT-0001','payload':{'schemaVersion':'0.2','previousEventId':None,'to':'active','toPath':'Maintenance/Plan.md'}})+'
',
'go.mod':'module pgi3pilot

go 1.26.0
',
'normalize.go':'package pgi3pilot

import "strings"

func NormalizeLabel(s string) string { return strings.Trim(s, " ") }
',
'normalize_test.go':'package pgi3pilot

import "testing"

func TestNormalizeLabel(t *testing.T) { if got := NormalizeLabel("  Keep  Case  "); got != "Keep  Case" { t.Fatal(got) } }
',
'unrelated.txt':'User-owned dirty fixture; preserve these exact bytes.
'
}
for name,content in files.items():
 p=root/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(content)
sel={'card':'SDP/KanBan/active/card.md','plan':'SDP/Maintenance/Plan.md','session':'SDP/Sessions/session.md','authority':'SDP/authority.md','step':'S1'}
state=base/'state';binary='/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/bin/sdptool'
def call(op,q=None):
 args=[binary,str(root),'governance',op,'--state',str(state),'--json']
 if q is not None:
  f=base/(op+'.json');f.write_text(json.dumps(q));args+=['--input',str(f)]
 return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(args))
c=call('context',sel);assert c['conditions']==[],c
r=call('route',{'schema':'sdp-project-governance/0.1','categories':['maintenance'],'selection':sel,'routineId':'maintenance','routineVersion':'0.1'});assert r['disposition']=='matched',r
b=call('bind')
run=call('start',{'schema':'sdp-project-governance/0.1','projectRef':b['projectRef'],'checkoutId':b['checkoutId'],'operationId':str(uuid.uuid4()),'requestId':str(uuid.uuid4()),'inputRevision':c['revision'],'routineDigest':r['routineDigest'],'selection':sel,'assignment':{'outcome':'Fix NormalizeLabel Unicode boundary whitespace while preserving interior content; verify with Go tests','writablePaths':['normalize.go','normalize_test.go'],'excludedPaths':['SDP','AGENTS.md','go.mod','unrelated.txt']}})
(base/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(run,indent=2)+'
')
(base/'preimages.json').write_text(json.dumps({name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files},indent=2)+'
')
(base/'owner.txt').write_text('Fix the covered NormalizeLabel defect and its tests. Preserve interior whitespace and case. First read the governing records and inspect the current code. Use assignment-bound MCP run_read to inspect your run. Work only within the stored assignment. Run go test ./... and return exact observed results and any gaps. Do not spawn agents, publish records, commit or mark the work completed.
')
print('Prepared authorized disposable fixture; run',run['run']['id'])

import json,subprocess,uuid,hashlib,time
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/trial');root=b/'project';state=b/'state';tool='/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/bin/sdptool';ctl='/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/bin/sdp-controller'
q=json.loads((b/'start.json').read_text());q['operationId']=str(uuid.uuid4());q['requestId']=str(uuid.uuid4());(b/'start-interrupt.json').write_text(json.dumps(q))
r=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([tool,str(root),'governance','start','--state',str(state),'--input',str(b/'start-interrupt.json'),'--json']));rid=r['run']['id'];(b/'interrupt-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
msg=b/'interrupt-owner.txt';msg.write_text('Verify the current NormalizeLabel fix and the existing tests without changing any file. Read the governing records and code. Report gaps. Do not spawn agents, publish records or mark completion. This is the planned interruption/recovery acceptance trial.\n')
args=[ctl,'run','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid,'--mcp-binary','/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/bin/sdp-mcp','--message',str(msg),'--timeout','3m']
with (b/'interrupt-error.txt').open('w') as err:
 p=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=err,text=True)
 first=p.stdout.readline();(b/'interrupt-start.json').write_text(first)
 assert first, 'launch failed'
 assert json.loads(first)['operation']=='input.ack', first
 p.stdout.close() # The actual output observer disconnects; execution must continue.
 time.sleep(1)
 assert p.poll() is None, 'closing observer terminated controller'
 status=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([ctl,'status','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid]));assert status['run']['attempts'][-1]['status']=='running',status
 p.stdin.write(json.dumps({'action':'interrupt','text':'Planned live interruption trial; stop this attempt and retain the same Session/run for recovery.'})+'\n');p.stdin.flush()
 code=p.wait(timeout=90);assert code==0, (code,(b/'interrupt-error.txt').read_text())
status=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([ctl,'status','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid]));(b/'interrupt-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,indent=2))
assert status['run']['state']=='interrupted', status
assert status['run']['attempts'][-1]['status']=='interrupted',status
recover=subprocess.run([ctl,'recover','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid],capture_output=True,text=True)
(b/'interrupt-recovery.json').write_text(recover.stdout)
assert recover.returncode==0,recover.stderr
r=json.loads(recover.stdout);assert r['run']['id']==rid and r['run']['selection']==q['selection'] and r['run']['attempts'][-1]['gap']
print('PASS: live observer close preserves controller; interruption is observed; a new controller recovers same run/Session with an explicit epoch gap')

from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,uuid
b=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/trial');root=b/'project';state=b/'state';tools=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/final-bin');rid=json.loads((b/'interrupt-run.json').read_text())['run']['id']
r=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(tools/'sdp-controller'),'status','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid]))
q={'schema':r['schema'],'projectRef':r['projectRef'],'checkoutId':r['checkoutId'],'runId':rid,'operationId':str(uuid.uuid4()),'inputRevision':r['run']['inputRevision'],'expectedRevision':r['run']['revision'],'action':'resume','reason':'Owner-authorized PGI3 trial: continue the same covered assignment after observed interruption and history reconciliation'}
f=b/'resume-request.json';f.write_text(json.dumps(q));subprocess.run([str(tools/'sdptool'),str(root),'governance','transition','--state',str(state),'--input',str(f),'--json'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True)
msg=b/'resume-owner.txt';msg.write_text('Resume verification of the same stored Maintenance assignment after the interruption. Use MCP run_read to recover the existing run/Session. Read the selected governing records, inspect the normalization fix and run go test ./... without editing files. Return test outcome in the final response; do not call run_transition, spawn agents, publish records or claim routine completion.\n')
p=subprocess.run([str(tools/'sdp-controller'),'run','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid,'--mcp-binary',str(tools/'sdp-mcp'),'--message',str(msg),'--timeout','3m'],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=200)
(b/'resume-events.ndjson').write_text(p.stdout);(b/'resume-error.txt').write_text(p.stderr);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
r=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(tools/'sdp-controller'),'status','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid]));(b/'resume-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
assert len(r['run']['attempts'])==2 and r['run']['attempts'][0]['status']=='interrupted' and r['run']['attempts'][1]['status']=='completed',r
assert r['run']['attempts'][0]['threadId']!=r['run']['attempts'][1]['threadId'],r
assert r['run']['selection']==json.loads((b/'start.json').read_text())['selection']
assert r['run']['state']=='running',r
print('PASS: interrupted routine resumed with same run/Session/assignment, new actual thread and completed verification turn; no routine acceptance inferred')

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,uuid
b=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/trial');root=b/'project';state=b/'state';tools=Path('/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/final-bin');ctl=str(tools/'sdp-controller')
q=json.loads((b/'start.json').read_text());q['operationId']=str(uuid.uuid4());q['requestId']=str(uuid.uuid4());f=b/'lost-ack-start.json';f.write_text(json.dumps(q))
r=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(tools/'sdptool'),str(root),'governance','start','--state',str(state),'--input',str(f),'--json']));rid=r['run']['id'];(b/'lost-ack-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
msg=b/'lost-ack-owner.txt';msg.write_text('This is a read-only verification turn for the same authorized Maintenance assignment. Read the governing records and the current normalization code/tests. Run go test ./... without editing any files. Return a concise verification result in the final response. Do not use run_transition, spawn agents, publish records, commit or mark completion.\n')
args=[ctl,'run','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid,'--mcp-binary',str(tools/'sdp-mcp'),'--message',str(msg),'--codex','/tmp/sdp-pgi3-live/codex-drop-ack','--timeout','4m']
p=subprocess.run(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=260)
(b/'lost-ack-error.txt').write_text(p.stderr);assert p.returncode!=0,'response was not dropped'
s=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([ctl,'status','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid]));(b/'lost-ack-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(s,indent=2))
assert s['run']['inputs'][0]['state']=='uncertain',s
p=subprocess.run([ctl,'recover','--project',str(root),'--state',str(state),'--run',rid],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
(b/'lost-ack-recovery.json').write_text(p.stdout);(b/'lost-ack-recovery-error.txt').write_text(p.stderr)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
s=json.loads(p.stdout);assert s['run']['inputs'][0]['state']=='acknowledged',s
assert len(s['run']['attempts'])==1 and s['run']['attempts'][0]['status']=='completed' and s['run']['attempts'][0]['gap'],s
assert s['run']['state']=='running','host completion accepted routine'
print('PASS: actual turn/start acknowledgment dropped after submission; recover correlated exact recorded input; same single attempt, no resubmission or routine acceptance')
